items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, didn't Marl Marie Young say that John Levy went down to the draft board...

ctx.x: I think he was having a little trouble with his wife and he would go off on an oblique angle or something. And John Levy went -- he went into Nutsville, he put on an act. Everybody was finding something to do to stay out of the war, you know?
Well, didn't Marl Marie Young say that John Levy went down to the draft board and said that he was eager to be there, please put a gun in his hand --
So he could shoot every white cat in the back of the head.
